# cpanel_mysql_remote_host (Data Source)

Looks up one remote host authorized to connect to the cPanel account's MySQL or MariaDB databases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_mysql_remote_host" "reporting" {
  host = "198.51.100.20"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) The IPv4 address, IPv4 CIDR prefix, IPv4 percent-wildcard pattern, or hostname to look up.

### Read-Only

- `note` (String) The note stored by cPanel for the remote host, or an empty string when none exists.
